ImageDescription.value:
This panel on the facade of the Church of San Pedro in Seville, Spain has text in Spanish explaining about a hidden bird in a ceramic altarpiece depicting "Blessed Souls of Purgatory." The panel is located below the ceramic altarpiece.

Google-translated into English it states:

"I'm from the Brotherhood of the Blessed Sacrament. The artist painted me and placed a little bird here—which is his way of signing his work—hidden in a corner. Everyone who found it gave their alms as they passed by and prayed to the Souls in Purgatory, and if they wanted to get married, they always succeeded quickly"
